evidence.claim: Registration is solved exactly and GT-free by exact-content anchor hashing (my test): anchors = voxels equal to their 3x7x7 max filter and above the frame's p99.5, key = hash of the raw uint16 3x5x5 patch, vote = anchor-coordinate difference. On 44b6_12dfb391 vs 44b6_3a861e03 (52 shared GT nodes), 3 frames x 8 frames gave ONE offset (dt,dz,dy,dx)=(-86,6,-114,75) with 158 votes. That equals the GT offset (note dz=6, not 0). Voxel equality on the 1.49M-voxel overlap = 1.0. Null pairs (vs 6bba_05b6850b and the unrelated 44b6_0113de3b): 0 hash hits. Cost ~0.3-0.5 s per frame on CPU.

MIP phase correlation is a weak detector here. Real 44b6 overlap peaks are 0.07-0.18, the 6bba null reaches 0.12, and (0,0) peaks are a fixed-pattern artefact. So the proposed 0.06 threshold passes many false candidates and relies entirely on the voxel check.

The proposed graph-only fusion (edge replacement between nodes matched mutually within 2.5 um) CANNOT reach most discordant FN. Of 200 discordant unique GT edges (FN in copy X, TP in copy Y; exp39+ef): Y's matched node has no X node within 2.5 um at both ends in 97 cases, at one end in 48 (72% in total). Only 10 cases (5%) have the same nodes with the edge missing; 41 share one end node; in 4 X matched other nodes. Mapping sanity on 2,012 concordant-TP edges: median copy-to-copy distance 0.90 um, 89.7% within 2.5 um, nearest node = matched node in 98.4%. On discordant edges the median is 4.05 um. So the lever is node-level (which detections exist and where), consistent with the 24 Sep correction that swaps are node-position errors.

evidence.claim: Simulating owner propagation (every copy takes the TP/FN status of the copy with the largest min(border um, 1 um x frames to clip end)) gives net +89 FN units on 44b6 (fixed minus broken, FN side only) = +0.0042 on 44b6 per-embryo units (D ~21,148), +0.0007 pooled over 199. By leak group: g0 +67, g1 +4, g2 +3, g3 +4, g4 +1, g6 +4, g7 +1, g8 +4, g9 +1, g5 0, g10 0. That is 9/11 positive and none negative, but 75% of the gain sits in the 24-video group 0.

Earlier measurements: 22% of 44b6 GT edge instances (4,374/19,826) and 25% of 44b6 FN lie in multi-copy regions. 198 unique edges are discordant and 24 are FN in every copy. The failing copy is nearer its crop edge. The chooser min(space um, frames) is right in 70-71% of cases, with 4% ties. Averaging copy positions takes the median GT distance from 1.34 to 1.24 um.

This is standard practice in large-volume tracking. Linajea solves the ILP blockwise with a context region at least as large as cell motion, adds neighbour solutions as constraints, sets appear/disappear costs to zero at block edges, and never runs overlapping blocks at the same time (Daisy). The premise is that predictions near block edges are less reliable than predictions with full context. Ultrack stitches overlapping time windows using one shared frame as a constraint.
evidence.source: Malin-Mayor et al., Automated reconstruction of whole-embryo cell lineages by learning from sparse annotations, Nat Biotech 2023 / bioRxiv 10.1101/2021.07.28.454016 (https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2021.07.28.454016v1.full); Ultrack docs https://royerlab.github.io/ultrack/ and Nature Methods 2025 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-025-02778-0

implementation_notes:
REGISTRATION (replace the MIP/FFT step). Exact-content anchor hashing, per test video and frame: (1) torch max_pool3d(kernel (3,7,7), stride 1, pad) on the raw uint16 frame, run on the GPU in the detection loop or as a standalone pass. Anchors = voxels where raw == max and raw > the frame's p99.5, at least 1 voxel from z borders and 3 from y/x borders. (2) Key = 64-bit hash of the raw 3x5x5 uint16 patch (blake2b digest_size 8, or xxhash). (3) Put every (video, t, z, y, x) into one global dict keyed by hash. Every bucket with more than one video votes for (video pair, dt, dz, dy, dx). (4) Accept a pair offset only if it has >= 30 votes AND raw voxels are exactly equal (>= 99.9%) on the 3D overlap for 3 frames spread over the overlap. (5) Require >= 5 overlapping frames and >= 5% spatial overlap. Without this, the 6bba one-frame boundary overlaps would be accepted and position averaging would no longer be an exact no-op. Pitfalls: frozen or duplicated frames inside a clip create secondary votes at dt +-1, so take the vote mode and let the equality check decide. Offsets include nonzero dz (+6 seen), so do not assume dz = 0. Offsets can be any integer in y/x (every phase mod 4). Restrict pairs to the same filename prefix (the embryo code) for speed and safety, and still report cross-prefix hits as a sanity check (expected 0). CPU cost: max_filter ~0.3 s/frame, i.e. ~100 min for 20k frames on one core. So use the GPU in the kernel (seconds) and 4 processes on the Kaggle CPU lab (~25-30 min for 199 videos).

FUSION. Graph-only rules (a) and (b) reach only ~5-7% of discordant FN (measured: 72% of discordant cases lack a corresponding node). Replace them with a DISAGREEMENT-COMPONENT SPLICE, a consensus version of linajea's core/context rule. For each accepted pair (A, B) on the final graphs (post-tail, after divinsert and float coordinates):
(i) Map B's nodes into A's frame. Per frame, solve a Hungarian correspondence between A and B nodes within 2.5 um.
(ii) A node is AGREE if it is corresponded, its predecessor edge maps to B's predecessor edge (or both have none) and its successor edges map likewise.
(iii) Take the non-agree nodes of both copies inside the overlap. Connect them by each copy's edges, and by same-frame proximity <= 7 um between A and B non-agree nodes (this groups displaced or swapped detections). Their connected components are DISAGREEMENT components.
(iv) Score each component by the mean over its nodes of s = min(spatial border distance in um, using z 1.625 and yx 0.40625 per voxel; 1 um x frames to the nearest clip end), computed in each copy's own crop. The copy with the larger mean owns the component, with a hysteresis margin of 1 um: on a tie or within the margin, keep A.
(v) If B owns the component, delete A's nodes and edges in it and insert B's. Edges from or to AGREE nodes are rewired through the correspondence, so seams sit only at nodes where both copies already agree. This is what keeps seam losses small.
(vi) Enforce at most 1 predecessor per node. Leave forks alone in v1: skip any component that contains a node with 2 successors in either copy.
(vii) Drop the spliced part of any newly created component shorter than 3 nodes.
(viii) With 3 or more copies, the owner is the argmax over all copies, so every video converges to the same answer. This automatically covers a_tail (B's surviving long track replaces A's filtered track, so no pre-filter graph is needed), a_never (B's node is imported), and swap/u_div/v_taken (B's node positions replace A's).
Node-count guard: if the spliced video's node count changes by more than +0.5%, revert that video.
Position averaging (e) is optional: v2, on AGREE nodes only (max +0.0005).
Place everything in one standalone final notebook cell: read submission.csv (dataset,row_type,node_id,t,z,y,x,source_id,target_id, written by write_test_submission), register on the test zarrs, splice, rewrite the csv, and fall back to the untouched csv on any exception. The lab replays the same function on per-video graphs from friend A's cache.
refined_change: Final standalone post-pass (flag OVERLAP_SPLICE). (1) GT-free registration of all test-video pairs with the same filename prefix by exact-content anchor hashing (3x7x7 local maxima above p99.5, hash of the raw 3x5x5 patch, offset votes). Accept a pair only with >= 30 votes, exact voxel equality >= 99.9% on 3 overlap frames, >= 5 overlapping frames and >= 5% spatial overlap. (2) For each accepted pair, splice the final graphs by disagreement components: Hungarian node correspondence within 2.5 um; agree = matched nodes whose in- and out-edges also match; non-agree nodes grouped by both copies' edges plus same-frame proximity <= 7 um; each component is owned by the copy with the larger mean min(border um, 1 um x frames to clip end), margin 1 um, ties keep A. The owner's nodes and edges replace the other copy's, seams are rewired only through agree nodes, components containing forks are skipped, new fragments under 3 nodes are dropped, and a video reverts if its node count rises by more than 0.5%. With 3+ copies the global argmax owner decides. (3) Exact no-op when no pair is accepted (6bba-type embryo, dummy test). Drop the MIP/FFT registration and the edge-only rules (a)/(b); they reach only ~5% of discordant FN. OPTIONAL, needs user approval: a structure bit-probe before engineering. One submission whose kernel runs only the registration and raises if >= 1 exact-overlap pair exists in the hidden test. An error means at least one test embryo (public or private, since the rerun covers the whole test set) has overlapping crops. A valid (weak) score means the line is dead.
refined_lab_test:
Kaggle CPU kernel with the competition train zarrs and friend A's cache; exp48 tails (leaf prune 0.3 + divinsert); official metric; no laptop compute.
Step A, registration (GT-free, ~30 min on 4 processes): hashing over all 199 videos, within-prefix pairs plus a cross-prefix check. Pass criteria: >= 60 of the 65 GT-linked 44b6 pairs found at the exact GT offset (+-1 voxel); 0 accepted 6bba pairs once the >= 5-frame rule applies (report the one-frame 6bba boundary overlaps that were found and rejected); 0 cross-embryo pairs. Report extra 44b6 pairs without shared GT.
Step B0, sanity: re-run the owner-propagation simulation on exp48 match files. Expect roughly +89 FN units (+0.004 on 44b6), since exp39+ef measured +89 with group 0 = +67.
Step B, splice: score all 199 videos. Gate on the 44b6 per-embryo delta >= +0.002, with leak-group bootstrap CI > 0 (11 groups; also report the result without group 0, which holds 75% of the simulated gain) and wins/losses counted per leak group. 6bba must be bit-identical. Node-ratio change <= +0.3% on 44b6. Division TP/FP must be unchanged (forks are skipped). Report the multiplier term separately.
Readout: splice fix rate vs the simulated ceiling (the gap is the seam loss), per FN class, and the number of components replaced.
Then one LB probe: best base + splice. The public score changes only if the public embryo has overlapping crops.
expected_gain: Ceiling on a 44b6-type embryo is +0.004 (perfect splice, FN side only; measured +89 FN units / D 21,148), and a realistic +0.002-0.003 after seam losses. That is zero on a 6bba-type embryo, and pooled lab +0.0004-0.0007. Unconditional public expectation is about +0.001 (P(overlap-rich public embryo) ~0.5 is a guess, since no source describes the test cropping). This alone cannot close the 0.948 -> 0.97 gap. Its value is as a cheap, low-harm add-on plus a structural diagnostic for the private embryo. Cost: ~1 day of CPU engineering, <5 min of kernel runtime with GPU hashing, and 1-2 probes (an optional bit-probe, then the real one).
